    Description
    CarouselLayout
    The pure positioning mathematics of the 3D window carousel, lifted out of the scene graph so it is headless-testable.
    CarouselLayout.Pose
    The pose of one card: a translation, the tangential rotation about Z that turns it to face outward from the circle, a uniform scale, and whether it is the front (selected) card.
    SwingNodeThumbnailSource
    The default WindowThumbnailSource: it hands out the live Texture2D a window's SwingNode already paints into, so a carousel card shows the real, updating window content for Swing-to-node windows (the great majority of desktop apps).
    WindowCarousel3D
    The native 3D desktop's window switcher rendered as a CDViewer-style circular carousel: one card per open window, seated on a circle in the screen plane with the selected window at the front, enlarged, and centred.
    WindowSwitcher3D
    The window switcher as a scene-graph node: the CDViewer-style WindowCarousel3D that WindowSwitcherPlugin mounts on the front-most DesktopHudLayer.
    WindowSwitcherKeys
    The keystroke vocabulary of the native 3D desktop's window switcher, reduced to a pure function so it is headless-testable.
    WindowSwitcherKeys.Kind
    What a switcher keystroke means.
    WindowSwitcherPlugin
    The Alt+Tab-style window switcher for the native 3D desktop: the plugin counterpart of the 2D/Swing desktop's WindowCyclerOverlay, and the third window-management feature ported off the taskbar (after WorkspacePlugin and WindowSnapPlugin).
    WindowThumbnailSource
    Supplies the miniature each carousel card shows for an open window.
